launcher.handoff.first.title: Terminus gets a new engine
launcher.handoff.first.body: Your workspaces, tasks, accounts and vault move to the new engine without being copied: they stay in the same folder. First, Terminus 0.2.74 has to close and finish what it is doing.
launcher.handoff.readopt.title: Terminus 0.2.74 opened this data again
launcher.handoff.readopt.body: After the engine change, Terminus 0.2.74 opened this folder again, or the app moved. The engine has to take the data back; nothing is deleted.
launcher.handoff.nothing_killed: Nothing is force-closed: each task is allowed to finish.
launcher.step.window.pending: Close the Terminus 0.2.74 window if it is open
launcher.step.window.open: Terminus 0.2.74 is still open: close it. While it is open it restarts its service
launcher.step.work.pending: The previous Terminus is finishing what it has in progress

launcher.step.work.tasks.one: The previous Terminus is working on {count} task
launcher.step.work.tasks.other: The previous Terminus is working on {count} tasks

launcher.step.work.done: The previous Terminus finished and closed
launcher.step.engine.pending: Start the new engine with your data
launcher.step.engine.done: The new engine has your data
launcher.failed.title: The Terminus engine did not start
launcher.failed.reason.engine_missing: The engine is missing from the installation. Install Terminus again.
launcher.failed.reason.not_private: An engine file is not private: another account on this computer can read it. The window does not connect like that.
launcher.failed.reason.service_busy: Another process holds the data and does not let it go.
launcher.failed.reason.authority_incompa: The engine does not accept this data folder as it is.
launcher.failed.back: To go back to Terminus 0.2.74: close this window, install 0.2.74 from {url} and open it. Your data is still in this folder and 0.2.74 opens it:
launcher.blank_0274: Terminus 0.2.74 is open on this data and stays blank while this engine works: close it. To go back to 0.2.74, close this window and wait for the engine to finish its tasks and stop (5 minutes without clients).
launcher.failed.reason.adoption_required: The engine asks to adopt the data again and could not.
launcher.failed.reason.engine_start_fail: The engine closed while starting or did not answer in time.
